mechanism: Perphenazine may inhibit CYP3A4 and increase rosuvastatin exposure, while both drugs can cause myopathy/rhabdomyolysis and perphenazine increases QT prolongation risk with statin-induced electrolyte changes.
action: Monitor for muscle pain, weakness, and CK elevation; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower CYP450 interaction potential or lower rosuvastatin dose; baseline and periodic lipid/CK monitoring recommended.
